title: Pittsburgh Improv | Pittsburgh Improv latest events and promotions. Located in Pittsburgh’s thriving Waterfront shopping area, the Improv offers a mix of comedy, food and cocktails. The club regularly hosts A list talent such as Chris Kattan, Eddie Griffin and more.
